# mani

Russian-language personal finance application at https://moimani.ai/

## Current stage, confirmed by the product owner on 2026-09-18

- The first public release is under store review
- Public App Store, Google Play and RuStore download links are not available yet
- The website accepts requests to be notified when the application is published
- The first release focuses on the basic view of accounts and transactions
- A more capable intelligent model, deeper analysis and personalized explanations are planned for the next update, not available first-release features
- Smart signals on the website are illustrative examples, not analysis of the visitor's data
- No confirmed publication date or complete supported-bank list is announced
- The website retains the first-1000-users offer; sharing a referral link is optional and does not promise accelerated access
- mani does not initiate payments or transfers

## Description

Start with a clearer picture of your money. mani brings accounts and transactions into one view, with deeper intelligent analysis planned for the next update
